items.title: Freeze the M0 drivability baseline fixture contract
items.context: Record a stable regression fixture contract for the rule-free fix-git run: baseline commands-to-DEV is 80+ commands and never reached DEV; the fixture must define what is measured and how future M6 comparison reports are interpreted without treating an agent narrative as proof.
items.userSees: A future maintainer can identify the exact baseline metric and fixture contract before changing INIT guidance.
excludes: Do not run the full autonomous fix-git experiment in this story unless a lightweight deterministic fixture already exists.
Do not change any lifecycle evidence requirement.

items.title: Route session_brief and next INIT guidance to init_preflight
items.context: Update INIT-phase next-step logic so session_brief / next point agents to lattice init_preflight --storyId=<id> before story_advance INIT_CHECK. Preserve non-git guidance and read-only behavior.
items.userSees: For an INIT story, lattice session_brief and lattice next tell the agent to run init_preflight instead of blindly attempting story_advance INIT_CHECK.
excludes: Do not auto-run init_preflight from session_brief.
Do not write evidence or advance phase.

items.title: Route story_create and global help INIT flow through init_preflight
items.context: Update story_create INIT hint and the global lattice --help development-flow block so agents see the full INIT prerequisite route before story_advance INIT_CHECK.
items.userSees: Freshly created INIT stories and top-level help no longer advertise a direct INIT_CHECK jump without preflight guidance.
excludes: Do not implement M2 checklist self-seeding in this story.
Do not alter unrelated help sections.

items.title: Add INIT_CHECK failure guidance toward init_preflight without weakening gates
items.context: When the INIT_CHECK gate fails on the first missing prerequisite, append exact guidance to run init_preflight so the agent can see all missing prerequisites. Keep evaluateScopeAntiExpansionGate fail-closed unless a separate structural story changes aggregation.
items.userSees: A failed story_advance INIT_CHECK points to init_preflight and controlled init_check_repair guidance where relevant, without implying any evidence exemption.
excludes: Do not bypass dual INIT reviewers.
Do not auto-exempt by task size or risk.
Do not implement M7 ceremony redesign.

items.title: Add focused tests for M1 routing behavior
items.context: Add or update focused tests/smokes that assert INIT session guidance, story_create hint, global help flow, and INIT_CHECK failure guidance name init_preflight and do not claim readiness or production completion.
items.userSees: The M1 routing fixes are protected against regression by machine checks rather than relying on prose review.
excludes: Do not require network or real external hosts.
Do not depend on hidden scorer state.
